title: Await
summary: Render a stable promise through Preact Suspense, with a local rejection fallback.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: resolve accepts a value or Promise. children receives the resolved value, inferred as Awaited<T>. errorElement is optional and may be null to deliberately render nothing on rejection.

sections.title: Pending and resolved values
sections.body: Place Await inside Suspense from preact/compat. Pending promises suspend to that boundary; fulfilled promises call children. A non-Promise value calls children immediately. Preserve the promise identity between renders instead of creating a new promise inside the component.

sections.title: Rejections
sections.body: When errorElement is supplied, Await renders it instead of children. Otherwise the rejection is thrown during rendering and must be handled by a Preact error boundary. useRouteError reads router request errors; it does not expose this locally handled promise rejection.

sections.title: Server rendering
sections.body: Await does not start requests. With renderApplication, nested loader promises remain pending during SSR: wrap Await in Suspense to stream a fallback. By default, hydration begins after the document completes. Set renderApplication options.earlyHydration to true to hydrate the shell before optional promises settle. Route-data HTTP transport still resolves deferred fields before JSON serialization.
